ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 60% high-intensity white pixels localized on the lateral lobes and 40% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central region and along the fluke margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central dark 'butterfly' shaped region extending from the peduncle to the trailing edge. Left lobe contains multiple vertical low-intensity streaks. Right lobe exhibits smaller, scattered dark pixel clusters and a larger dark smudge near the trailing edge midpoint.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an internal pixel angle of approximately 70-80 degrees, extending to a depth of roughly 12% of the visible fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys of 2-5 pixels) and significant high-amplitude protrusions at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch transitioning into a sharp, upward-sweeping curve toward the distal terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of irregular, high-contrast pixels located at the extreme tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization. Several small, circular dark clusters are visible on the interior white field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical dark line on the white field of the left lobe; multiple faint, intersecting curvilinear markings visible on the medial surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular texture and biological buildup at the lateral tips; significant jaggedness along the trailing edge suggests historical tissue loss or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'ragged' distal margins where the biological encrustation extends beyond the primary fluke contour.
